title: REQ · Worker module loads YAML config with defaults and env overrides
summary: Worker config LoadFS reads YAML, applies defaults and STORYFORGE_WORKER_* overrides
description: Context: backend/internal/config/config.go has the LoadFS(fsys, name, getenv) pattern; the worker has none. Desired behavior: backend/worker module exposes config.LoadFS with the same shape. Expected result: a validated Config for the worker. Why: the runner needs configured paths and timeouts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a YAML file with only worker.repo_path, when LoadFS runs, then PollInterval is 30s, ExecutionTimeout is 30m, MaxRetries is 2 and Store.Dir is .storyforge/executions
Given STORYFORGE_WORKER_REPO_PATH is set, when LoadFS runs, then it overrides the YAML repo_path
Given an empty repo_path after env overrides, when LoadFS runs, then it returns an error
technical_constraints: Mirror the LoadFS(fsys fs.FS, name string, getenv func(string) string) signature of the backend config
definition_of_done: config package builds and example YAML parses
